text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Walking around town on a day off—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Fine... You've gotta be satisfied by 
now. Let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Nope, not going back just yet~♪ Our ramen 
tour has only just begun!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Going to three shops is more than enough 
already...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying? The real fun starts 
now♪ Shakur, make sure to keep me company 
properly, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I won't let you collect that 
data of mine you wanted.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch... I should've defined the negotiation 
terms more strictly.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's Air Shakur. Seeing her in 
person, her gaze is pretty sharp...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's edgy. When she snaps it's 
crazy, and won't she run totally wild in 
the upcoming race?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Crap, did she hear us?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Scary... let's just get out of here...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey Shakur, what does "edgy" mean? Is it a 
compliment?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, it's an insult. It means dangerous 
to touch, an oddball who won't conform to 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Really? Bad-mouthing is bad manners, 
we have to teach them!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't bother doing pointless hassle. It's 
meaningless, so drop it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Doesn't that make you feel sad, 
Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Not even a tiny bit. Doesn't 
shave off a single millimeter of me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Noise from around me isn't even an 
uncertain variable. Stuff like that, I 
shut out completely.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Besides, people like that shut up on their 
own if you keep winning. So just leave 'em 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see... You really are noble, Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah? What kind of logic converts what I 
just said into a word like that?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Charging straight toward your ideals with 
single-minded devotion. Just that alone is 
noble, I think.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But you know, if the noise ever starts 
bothering you... let's drown it out with 
the slurping sound of ramen♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll join you as many times as you want! 
I'll follow you to any ramen shop you 
choose.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You just want to go to a ramen shop 
yourself! ...Sheesh, what a pain you are.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? But I'm actually a girl with quite a 
big appetite, you know? I'll prove it to 
you at the next ramen shop!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's not what I meant. ...Hmph.
